value.rationale: Q3 is a canonical cubic graph, and degree cutoff two is its unique nontrivial higher-matching degree relaxation; cutoff three is the full simplex. The exact integral homotopy type distinguishes a natural graph complex from its ordinary cutoff-one complex (four 2-spheres), and offers a meaningful topological benchmark for higher matching complexes, not an arbitrary numerical slice.
